016package org.vafer.jdeb.ant;
017
018import java.io.File;
019import java.io.FileInputStream;
020import java.io.IOException;
021import org.vafer.jdeb.mapping.LsMapper;
022import org.vafer.jdeb.mapping.PermMapper;
023
024/**
025 * Ant "mapper" element acting as factory for the entry mapper.
026 * Supported types: ls, perm
027 */
028public final class Mapper {
029
030  private String mapperType = "perm";
031  private File src;
032
033  private String prefix;
034  private int strip;
035  private int uid = -1;
036  private int gid = -1;
037  private String user;
038  private String group;
039  private String fileMode;
040  private String dirMode;
041
042  public void setType(final String pType) {
043    mapperType = pType;
044  }
045
046  public void setSrc(final File pSrc) {
047    src = pSrc;
048  }
049
050  public void setPrefix(final String pPrefix) {
051    prefix = pPrefix;
052  }
053
054  public void setStrip(final int pStrip) {
055    strip = pStrip;
056  }
057
058  public void setUid(final int pUid) {
059    uid = pUid;
060  }
061
062  public void setGid(final int pGid) {
063    gid = pGid;
064  }
065
066  public void setUser(final String pUser) {
067    user = pUser;
068  }
069
070  public void setGroup(final String pGroup) {
071    group = pGroup;
072  }
073
074  public void setFileMode(final String pFileMode) {
075    fileMode = pFileMode;
076  }
077
078  public void setDirMode(final String pDirMode) {
079    dirMode = pDirMode;
080  }
081
082  public org.vafer.jdeb.mapping.Mapper createMapper() throws IOException {
083    if ("perm".equalsIgnoreCase(mapperType)) {
084      return new PermMapper(
085        uid,
086        gid,
087        user,
088        group,
089        fileMode,
090        dirMode,
091        strip,
092        prefix
093      );
094    }
095
096    if ("ls".equalsIgnoreCase(mapperType)) {
097      try {
098        return new LsMapper(new FileInputStream(src));
099      } catch (Exception e) {
100        e.printStackTrace();
101      }
102    }
103
104    throw new IOException("Unknown mapper type '" + mapperType + "'");
105  }
106}
